description:
Diagnose and fix a deadlock in the FinancialSystem project.

Scenario: The 'DeadlockDemo' simulation hangs indefinitely because of a threading issue in 'TransferService.java'.

Your task:
1. Run the 'DeadlockDemo' application to reproduce the hang.
2. Use the Eclipse Debugger to identify the threads involved in the deadlock.
3. Create a file named 'analysis.txt' in the project root folder (FinancialSystem/) and write the names of the two stuck threads.
4. Modify 'src/main/java/com/financial/core/TransferService.java' to prevent the deadlock by implementing a resource ordering strategy (lock accounts based on their ID order).
5. Verify the fix by running 'DeadlockDemo' again - it should print 'SIMULATION COMPLETED' and exit.
